partnership_announcements.description: Thread and FlyGuys have announced a strategic partnership to enhance utility asset management through advanced data solutions. overview_description.description: Thread operates as an online personal styling platform designed to help men find clothes. The platform offers a combination of human stylist and machine learning algorithms, where they receive personalized information from human stylists and suggestions from an algorithm that understands the customer's preferences over time, helping men to dress well without having to go shopping.
